# UniVRM (VRM 0.x) for VPM

`com.vrmc.univrm` 0.131.3 from [UniVRM](https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM) by the VRM Consortium (MIT License), repackaged for
the Orbiters VPM listing so VRChat Creator Companion can install it (Orbiters' My Avatar exports VRM with it).

The package files are UniVRM's own, unchanged, from the
[v0.131.3 release](https://github.com/vrm-c/UniVRM/releases/tag/v0.131.3), with their .meta files. Only
`package.json` gains VPM fields (`vpmDependencies`), and its sample list goes (the release ships no samples).

Orbiters is not associated with the VRM Consortium. Report UniVRM issues upstream; packaging issues here.
